required_measurement: replicated, coordinate-registered film maps with pointwise uncertainty
experimental_design: repeat the same condition without changing wafer orientation or metrology coordinates
resolves: measurement noise versus reproducible in-plane residual structure

required_measurement: wall or near-wall species/transport fields; spatial temperature only if the uniform-temperature assumption is invalid
experimental_design: save the fields on the same wafer coordinates for conditions that change flow or pressure, while recording the uniform wafer temperature
resolves: surface-response variation versus local delivery under the stated uniform-temperature assumption
workflow_use: fit spatial drivers on identification conditions and evaluate centered residuals on held-out wafers

required_measurement: independent wafer maps spanning the intended operating window
experimental_design: reserve complete conditions before choosing equations or spatial corrections
resolves: transfer of the correction rather than interpolation of one map
workflow_use: apply the frozen correction and compare centered R2, range capture, and residual maps

experimental_design: use factorial or near-orthogonal A/B/I perturbations, including low or off levels for one candidate at a time
resolves: confounded role directions and A/B exchange alternatives
workflow_use: require full condition-contrast rank and stable assignment across condition refits

experimental_design: span dilute supply, transition, and plateau regimes without changing all species by the same factor
resolves: linear supply response versus adsorption saturation and competitive site occupation
workflow_use: compare each parent equation with its exact reductions

required_measurement: surface-state or outlet-species observation tied to the anonymous inputs
experimental_design: measure coverage, oxidation state, or consumption/byproduct response during an independent perturbation
resolves: an empirical role association versus a chemically assigned pathway
workflow_use: combine film prediction with the measured state or pathway observation

required_measurement: time-resolved uptake, thickness, or surface-state response
experimental_design: apply concentration steps or separated pulses with sampling faster than the observed relaxation
resolves: storage, release, conversion, and redox time constants
workflow_use: fit the dynamic AIB, ALD, or MvK state history rather than a steady lumped group

experimental_design: repeat independent concentration transients at several temperatures with matched transport characterization
resolves: Arrhenius prefactors and activation energies from concentration effects
workflow_use: share activation parameters across temperature conditions and validate temperature transfer

required_measurement: site density and absolute wall concentration or reacting-wall molar flux
experimental_design: measure or calibrate active-site capacity, stoichiometry, diffusivity, and wall-normal transport
resolves: coverage turnover frequency and elementary constants in physical units
workflow_use: close molar surface and transport fluxes with Gamma_s and propagate their uncertainty

experimental_design: repeat the transients used for estimation and retain a new recipe as an external test
resolves: practical parameter intervals and predictive uncertainty
workflow_use: check sensitivity rank, profile intervals, parameter correlation, and no-refit prediction
